verses.sloka: अथोवाच रघुश्रेष्ठः सागरम् दारुणम् वचः ।अद्य त्वाम् शोषयिष्यामि सपातालम् महार्णव ॥६-२२-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: athovāca raghuśreṣṭhaḥ sāgaram dāruṇam vacaḥ ।adya tvām śoṣayiṣyāmi sapātālam mahārṇava ॥6-22-1॥।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Rama uttered, "I shall make you dry up to the underworld", to the ocean that made his terrific presence.
translations.hindi: रघुश्रेष्ठ श्रोरामचन्द्र जी समुद्र को सम्वोधन कर यह दारुण वयन बोले कि, हे महाणव ! आज में तेरा पाताल तक का जल सुखा डालू गा

verses.transliteration: śaranirdagdhatoyasya pariśuṣkasya sāgara ।mayā nihatasattvasya pāmsurutpadyate mahān ॥6-22-2॥।।

translations.english: "O Ocean When your water is dried up to the core by my arrows, huge sand will appear."
translations.hindi: हे सागर ! मेरे वाणों द्वारा तेरा जल सूख जायगा । ते भीतर रहने वाले समस्त जलजन्तु मर जाँयगे। फिर खूब धूल उड़ने लगेगी

verses.sloka: मत्कार्मुकनिसृष्टेन शरवर्षेण सागर ।परम् तीरम् गमिष्यन्ति पद्भिरेव प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-२२-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: matkārmukanisṛṣṭena śaravarṣeṇa sāgara ।param tīram gamiṣyanti padbhireva plavaṅgamāḥ ॥6-22-3॥।।

translations.english: "O Ocean, now the monkeys will go to the other side of the shore on your drying up with all the creatures inhabiting you by the rain of arrows showered by me."
translations.hindi: हे सागर मेरे धनुष से छूटे हुए तीरों की वर्षा से, वानर उस पार पैदल ही चले जांयगे

verses.sloka: विचिन्वन्नाभिजानासि पौरुषम् वापि विक्रमम् ।दाव्नवालय सम्तापम् मत्तो नाम गमिष्यसि ॥६-२२-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: vicinvannābhijānāsi pauruṣam vāpi vikramam ।dāvnavālaya samtāpam matto nāma gamiṣyasi ॥6-22-4॥।।

translations.english: "You, who are the abode of demons are not aware of my valour and prowess. You are not aware of the sorrow that you will face from me."
translations.hindi: हे दानवालय | तू मेरे बल और पराक्रम को नहीं जानता ओर मत्त होने के कारण न तुके आगे होने वाले अपने सन्ताप ही का कुछ ज्ञान है.

verses.sloka: ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण सम्योज्य ब्रह्मदण्डनिभम् शरम् ।सम्योज्य धनुषि श्रे ष्ठे विचकर्ष महाबलः ॥६-२२-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: brāhmeṇāstreṇa samyojya brahmadaṇḍanibham śaram ।samyojya dhanuṣi śre ṣṭhe vicakarṣa mahābalaḥ ॥6-22-5॥।।

translations.english: Rama proceeded to stretch the mighty bow that resembled the rod of punishment of Brahma energized by Brahma and released that best of bows.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन्विकृष्टे सहसा राघवेण शरासने ।रोदसी सम्पफालेव पर्वताश्च चकम्पिरे ॥६-२२-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasminvikṛṣṭe sahasā rāghaveṇa śarāsane ।rodasī sampaphāleva parvatāśca cakampire ॥6-22-6॥।।

translations.english: When Rama released the arrows from the bow, at once the sky to the earth including mountains trembled.
translations.hindi: जब श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने सहसा वह बाण चलाने को रोदा खींचा तब ऐसा जान पड़ा, सानों आकाश और प्रथिवी फटी पड़ती है । उस समय पहाड़ कांपने लगे

verses.sloka: तमश्च लोकमावव्रे दिशश्च न चकाशिरे ।प्रतिचुक्षुभिरे चाशु सराम्सि सरितस्तदा ॥६-२२-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tamaśca lokamāvavre diśaśca na cakāśire ।praticukṣubhire cāśu sarāmsi saritastadā ॥6-22-7॥।।

translations.english: Then darkness engulfed the world, the directions were not noticeable and further the rivers were agitated.
translations.hindi: तमश्च लोकमावत्र दिशश्च न चकाशिरे । परिचुक्षुभिरे चाशु सरांसि सरितस्तथा ॥७ सवत्रअन्धकार छा गया, दिशाएँ प्रकाशशून्य हो गयीं सरोवरें और नदियां खलबला उठी

verses.sloka: तिर्यक् च सह नक्षत्रैः सम्गतौ चन्द्रभास्करौ ।भास्कराम्शुभिरादीप्तम् तमसा च समावृतम् ॥६-२२-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tiryak ca saha nakṣatraiḥ samgatau candrabhāskarau ।bhāskarāmśubhirādīptam tamasā ca samāvṛtam ॥6-22-8॥।।

translations.english: The Sun and moon moved obliquely (from south to North) along with the stars. On account of the darkness that covered even the sun was not shining. The sky lighted by the meteors shone and unparalleled thunder shot forth.
translations.hindi: नक्षत्रों सहित सूर्य चन्द्र की गति तिरछी हो गई । उस समय सूयं के रहते भी आकारा में अन्धकार छाया हुआ था

verses.sloka: प्रचकाशे तदाकाशमुल्काशतविदीपितम् ।अन्तरिक्षाच्च निर्घाता निर्जग्मुरतुलस्वनाः ॥६-२२-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: pracakāśe tadākāśamulkāśatavidīpitam ।antarikṣācca nirghātā nirjagmuratulasvanāḥ ॥6-22-9॥।।

verses.transliteration: vapuḥprakarṣeṇa vavurdivyamārutapaṅktyaḥ ।babhañja ca tadā vṛkṣān jaladānudvahan muhuḥ ॥6-22-10॥।।

translations.english: Then terrific wind blew breaking forth the clouds, which is an abode of cold water, taking them away in upward direction breaking trees.

verses.sloka: आरुजम्श्चैव शैलाग्रान् शिखराणि बभञ्ज च ।दिवि च स्म महावेगाः सम्हताः समहास्वनाः ॥६-२२-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: ārujamścaiva śailāgrān śikharāṇi babhañja ca ।divi ca sma mahāvegāḥ samhatāḥ samahāsvanāḥ ॥6-22-11॥।।

translations.english: Huge clouds collected were moving at extraordinary speed in the sky breaking mountain peaks. Those clouds in the sky sent forth fire of lightning making a loud sound.

verses.sloka: मुमुचुर्वैद्युतानग्नीम्स्ते महाशनयस्तदा ।यानि भूतानि दृश्यानि चुक्रुशुश्चाशनेः समम् ॥६-२२-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: mumucurvaidyutānagnīmste mahāśanayastadā ।yāni bhūtāni dṛśyāni cukruśuścāśaneḥ samam ॥6-22-12॥।।

Few other creatures came out of their place even though it was cold. Some were thrown off from their habitation in fear although they were together.

verses.transliteration: adṛśyāni ca bhūtāni mumucurbhairavasvanam ।śiśyare cābhibhūtāni samtrastāmyadvijanti ca ॥6-22-13॥।।

translations.english: The creatures like humans etc. That could be seen and those that could not be seen like devils and ghosts remained still out of fear. Few other creatures came out of their place even though it was cold. Some were thrown off from their habitation in fear although they were together.

verses.sloka: सम्प्रविव्यथिरे चापि न च पस्पन्दिरे भयात् ।सहभूतैः सतोयोर्मिः सनागः सहराक्षसः ॥६-२२-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: sampravivyathire cāpi na ca paspandire bhayāt ।sahabhūtaiḥ satoyormiḥ sanāgaḥ saharākṣasaḥ ॥6-22-14॥।।

translations.english: There after those waves of water with its creatures, serpents and demons were at once thrown off at terrific speed that was unprecedented. They were thrown beyond a yojana by the high tides.

verses.sloka: सहसाभूत्ततो वेगाद्भीमवेगो महोदधिः ।योजनम् व्यतिचक्राम वेलामन्यत्र सम्प्लवात् ॥६-२२-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: sahasābhūttato vegādbhīmavego mahodadhiḥ ।yojanam vyaticakrāma velāmanyatra samplavāt ॥6-22-15॥।।

translations.english: Rama the destroyer of foes did not attempt at the ocean that went far from the boundary, which was transgressing and overweening.

verses.transliteration: tato madhyāt samudrasya sāgaraḥ svayam utthitaḥ ।udayan hi mahāśailān meror iva divā karaḥ ॥6-22-17॥।।

translations.english: Then Sagara, the Lord of the ocean himself rising like the Sun over the mighty Meru Mountain rose from the middle of the ocean.

verses.transliteration: pannagaiḥ saha dīpta āsyaiḥ samudraḥ pratyadṛśyata ।snigdha vaidūrya samkāśo jāmbū nada vibhūṣitaḥ ॥6-22-18॥।।

translations.english: Then the Lord of the Ocean shining like the Vaidurya stone decked in pure gold as if blazing appeared along with serpents.
translations.hindi: उसके साथ बड़े बड़े प्रदीप्त मुह वाले साँप देख पडे । समुद्र के शरीर का रंग पन्न की तरह हरा और चमकीला था बह सोने के आभूषणणों से भूषित था

verses.transliteration: ratna mālya ambara dharaḥ padma patra nibha īkṣaṇaḥ ।sarvapuṣpamayīm divyām śirasā dhārayan srajam ॥6-22-19॥।।

translations.english: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.

verses.sloka: जातरूपमयैश्चैव तपनीयविभूषितो भूषणोत्तमैः ।आत्मजानाम् च रत्नानाम् भूषितो भूषणोत्तमैः ॥६-२२-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: jātarūpamayaiścaiva tapanīyavibhūṣito bhūṣaṇottamaiḥ ।ātmajānām ca ratnānām bhūṣito bhūṣaṇottamaiḥ ॥6-22-20॥।।

translations.english: Then Rama said, "O abode of Varuna, listen to me. In which location should I allow this unfailing mighty arrow to descend?"

verses.sloka: अमोघोऽयम् महाबाणः कस्मिन् देशे निपात्यताम् ।रामस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा तम् च दृष्ट्वा महाशरम् ॥६-२२-३०॥।।

translations.english: On hearing the question of Rama, the mighty ocean seeing the brilliant arrow spoke these words to him.

verses.sloka: महोदधिर्महातेजा राघवम् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।उत्तरेणावकाशोऽस्ति कश्चित्पुण्यतरो मम ॥६-२२-३१॥।।

translations.english: "To my north there is a holy place called Drumakulya, famous like you, and you have scope to act there (to descend the arrow)."

verses.sloka: द्रुमकुल्य इति ख्यातो लोके ख्यातो यथा भवान् ।उग्रदर्शनकर्माणो बहवस्तत्र दस्यवः ॥६-२२-३२॥।।
verses.transliteration: drumakulya iti khyāto loke khyāto yathā bhavān ।ugradarśanakarmāṇo bahavastatra dasyavaḥ ॥6-22-32॥।।

translations.english: "Marauders of terrific action, who are enemies of gods whose chief is Abhiras, live there drinking my (ocean) water performing sinful acts."

verses.sloka: आभीरप्रमुखाः पापाः पिबन्ति सलिलम् मम ।तैर्न तत्स्पर्शनम् पापम् सहेयम् पापकर्मभिः ॥६-२२-३३॥।।

translations.english: "Rama I cannot tolerate the touch of ones who are sinful in action. Therefore your (of descending this arrow down) mighty unfailing arrow can be released on them."
translations.hindi: हे राम ! मुझे उन पापियों का स्पशं भी सह्य नहं है । अत आप अपने इस उत्तम बाण को वहीं गिरा, कर सफल कौजिये

translations.english: On hearing the words of the request of Sagara and on account of seeing him, Rama let off the supreme arrow glowing (on the marauders).

Endowed with these virtues it became a holy and auspicious place.

translations.english: "This monkey is full of zeal. He will build a bridge over me, and I will bear it. In that way he is like his father."

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा उदधिर् नष्टः समुत्थाय नलस् ततः ।अब्रवीद् वानर श्रेष्ठो वाक्यम् रामम् महाबलः ॥६-२२-४६॥।।
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā udadhir naṣṭaḥ samutthāya nalas tataḥ ।abravīd vānara śreṣṭho vākyam rāmam mahābalaḥ ॥6-22-46॥।।

translations.english: Having spoken in that way, the Sea God disappeared. Nala, the foremost of vanaras, got up there after and spoke these words to mighty Rama.
translations.hindi: और उस वानरश्रेछ महावली वानर ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा । हे महाराज ! समुद्र ने जो कुछ कहा सत्य हे । सैं पिता के बरदान के प्रभाव से इस बिस्तृत वरुणालय महासागर पर पुल बाँध गा । इस सम्बन्ध में मैं यह अवश्य कहँँगा कि, संसार में दण्ड ही सब से बढ, कर काम बनाने वाला हे

verses.sloka: अहम् सेतुम् करिष्यामि विस्तीर्णे वरुण आलये ।पितुः सामर्थ्यम् आस्थाय तत्त्वम् आह महाउदधिः ॥६-२२-४७॥।।
verses.transliteration: aham setum kariṣyāmi vistīrṇe varuṇa ālaye ।pituḥ sāmarthyam āsthāya tattvam āha mahāudadhiḥ ॥6-22-47॥।।

translations.english: Adopting my father's skill, I shall build a bridge over the broad abode of Varuna—thus, truly, the ocean god has spoken.

verses.sloka: असौ तु सागरो भीमः सेतुकर्मदिदृक्षया ।ददौ दण्डभयाद्गाधम् राघवाय महोदधिः ॥६-२२-४८॥।।
verses.transliteration: asau tu sāgaro bhīmaḥ setukarmadidṛkṣayā ।dadau daṇḍabhayādgādham rāghavāya mahodadhiḥ ॥6-22-48॥।।

translations.english: This fearsome ocean of mighty Sagara (dug by Sagara) then allowed a passage for Rama, out of fear of punishment and also to witness the building of a bridge.

verses.sloka: मम मातुर् वरो दत्तो मन्दरे विश्व कर्मणा ।औरसस् तस्य पुत्रो अहम् सदृशो विश्व कर्मणा ॥६-२२-४९॥।।
verses.transliteration: mama mātur varo datto mandare viśva karmaṇā ।aurasas tasya putro aham sadṛśo viśva karmaṇā ॥6-22-49॥।।

translations.english: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."

verses.sloka: औरसस्तस्य पुत्रोऽहम् सदृशो विश्वकर्मणा।स्मारितोऽस्म्यहमेतेन तत्त्वमाह महोदधिः ॥६-२२-५०॥।।
verses.transliteration: aurasastasya putro'ham sadṛśo viśvakarmaṇā।smārito'smyahametena tattvamāha mahodadhiḥ ॥6-22-50॥।।

translations.english: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."
translations.hindi: रसस्तस्य पुत्रोऽहं सदृशो विश्वकर्मा । [पित्रोः प्रधादात्काकुत्स्थ ततः सेत्‌ करोम्यहम्‌ ]॥४०)॥ कि--./ मेरे समान तेरे पुत्र होगो । ” खो सैं उसका औरस पुत्र होने से उसी के समान हूँ । हे रघुनन्दन । पितात्री के वरदान से में सेतु की रचता करता हूँ

verses.sloka: न च अपि अहम् अनुक्तो वै प्रब्रूयाम् आत्मनो गुणान् ।समर्थ्श्चाप्यहम् सेतुम् कर्तुम् वै वरुणालये ॥६-२२-५१॥।।
verses.transliteration: na ca api aham anukto vai prabrūyām ātmano guṇān ।samarthścāpyaham setum kartum vai varuṇālaye ॥6-22-51॥।।

translations.english: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."

verses.sloka: तस्मादद्यैव बध्नन्तु सेतुम् वानरपुङ्गवाः ।ततो निसृष्ट रामेण सर्वतो हरि यूथपाः ॥६-२२-५२॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasmādadyaiva badhnantu setum vānarapuṅgavāḥ ।tato nisṛṣṭa rāmeṇa sarvato hari yūthapāḥ ॥6-22-52॥।।

translations.english: Then directed by Rama the Vanara troop leaders in hundreds and thousands sprang up gladly all over the huge forest.

verses.sloka: अभिपेतुर् महाअरण्यम् हृष्टाः शत सहस्रशः ।ते नगान् नग सम्काशाः शाखा मृग गण ऋषभाः ॥६-२२-५३॥।।
verses.transliteration: abhipetur mahāaraṇyam hṛṣṭāḥ śata sahasraśaḥ ।te nagān naga samkāśāḥ śākhā mṛga gaṇa ṛṣabhāḥ ॥6-22-53॥।।

translations.english: Mountain like bodied Vanara bulls there upon started collecting roots of trees from the foot of mountain and moved them into the sea.
translations.hindi: यह सुनते ही श्री रामचन्द्र जी ने वावरों को इस कास के लिए नियुक्त किया । तब तो लाखों बानर प्रसन्न हो बनौं में घुस गए

verses.sloka: बभन्जुर् वानरास् तत्र प्रचकर्षुः च सागरम् ।ते सालैः च अश्व कर्णैः च धवैर् वम्शैः च वानराः ॥६-२२-५४॥।।
verses.transliteration: babhanjur vānarās tatra pracakarṣuḥ ca sāgaram ।te sālaiḥ ca aśva karṇaiḥ ca dhavair vamśaiḥ ca vānarāḥ ॥6-22-54॥।।

translations.english: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.

verses.sloka: कुटजैर् अर्जुनैस् तालैस् तिकलैस् तिमिशैर् अपि ।बिल्वकैः सप्तपर्णैश्च कर्णिकारैश्च पुष्पितैः ॥६-२२-५५॥।।
verses.transliteration: kuṭajair arjunais tālais tikalais timiśair api ।bilvakaiḥ saptaparṇaiśca karṇikāraiśca puṣpitaiḥ ॥6-22-55॥।।

translations.english: The Vanaras brought sala, asvakarna, dhava, bamboo, kutaja arjuna, palmira, tilaka, trisaira, bilva, saptaparni trees karnikara plants with blossoms, mango trees and ashoka trees and dumped into the ocean.

verses.sloka: चूतैः च अशोक वृक्षैः च सागरम् समपूरयन् ।समूलामः च विमूलामः च पादपान् हरि सत्तमाः ॥६-२२-५६॥।।
verses.transliteration: cūtaiḥ ca aśoka vṛkṣaiḥ ca sāgaram samapūrayan ।samūlāmaḥ ca vimūlāmaḥ ca pādapān hari sattamāḥ ॥6-22-56॥।।

translations.english: Lifting some trees with roots and some without roots like the staff of Indra's flag, Vanaras hurled down the trees into the sea.
translations.hindi: हाथी के समान बढ़े बड़े शरीर वाले और महाबलवान्‌ बानर बड़े बढ़े पत्थरों को उखाड़ कर ऑर गाड़ियों पर ढोकर वहाँ पहुँचाने लगे

verses.sloka: इन्द्र केतून् इव उद्यम्य प्रजह्रुर् हरयस् तरून् ।तालान् दाडिमगुल्माम्श्च नारिकेलविभीतकान् ॥६-२२-५७॥।।
verses.transliteration: indra ketūn iva udyamya prajahrur harayas tarūn ।tālān dāḍimagulmāmśca nārikelavibhītakān ॥6-22-57॥।।

translations.english: They brought palmira, dadima, coconut, karira, bakula and nimba trees and dropped all of them into the ocean.
translations.hindi: रामचन्द्र जी के इस अदूशुत ओर दुष्कर कार्य को देख + देवता, सिद्ध, चारण और सहाषि सहसा वहाँ प्रकट हुए और समुद्र जल से अलग अलग श्रोरासचन्द्र जी का अभिषेक करने लगे

verses.sloka: करीरान् बकुलान्निम्बान् समाजह्रुरितस्ततः ।हस्तिमात्रान् महाकायाः पाषाणाम्श्च महाबलाः ॥६-२२-५८॥।।
verses.transliteration: karīrān bakulānnimbān samājahruritastataḥ ।hastimātrān mahākāyāḥ pāṣāṇāmśca mahābalāḥ ॥6-22-58॥।।

translations.english: The Vanaras of huge body size and strong like elephants collected stones and mountains, lifted them, and transported into the sea.

verses.sloka: पर्वताम्श्च समुत्पाट्य यन्त्रैः परिवहन्ति च ।प्रक्षिप्यमाणैर् अचलैः सहसा जलम् उद्धतम् ॥६-२२-५९॥।।
verses.transliteration: parvatāmśca samutpāṭya yantraiḥ parivahanti ca ।prakṣipyamāṇair acalaiḥ sahasā jalam uddhatam ॥6-22-59॥।।

translations.english: At once the water threw up (by dropping the mountains) rose, touching the sky and spreading.

verses.sloka: समुत्पतितम् आकाशम् अपासर्पत् ततस् ततः ।समुद्रम् क्षोभयामासुर्निपतन्तः समन्ततः ॥६-२२-६०॥।।
verses.transliteration: samutpatitam ākāśam apāsarpat tatas tataḥ ।samudram kṣobhayāmāsurnipatantaḥ samantataḥ ॥6-22-60॥।।

translations.english: On account of throwing into the sea it got stirred up Others held the rope over a hundred yojanas in breadth (to make it even).
translations.hindi: उन पत्थरों के बडे टुकड़ों को जल में डालने से समुद्र का जल इतना उछलता «कि, आकाश को चज्ञा जाता और फिर. नीचे गिर जाता था

verses.sloka: सूत्राण्यन्ये प्रगृह्णन्ति ह्यायतम् शतयोजनम् ।नलः चक्रे महासेतुम् मध्ये नद नदी पतेः ॥६-२२-६१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sūtrāṇyanye pragṛhṇanti hyāyatam śatayojanam ।nalaḥ cakre mahāsetum madhye nada nadī pateḥ ॥6-22-61॥।।

translations.english: Nala started the task of building the huge bridge in the centre of the ocean with Vanaras.
translations.hindi: ज चारों ओर पेड़ों और पत्थरों ता गिरा कर, बानरों ने समुद्र का जल खलबला दिया। कितने ही वानर सी योजन लम्बे सूत को थाम पुल की सिधाई ठीक करते थे

verses.sloka: स तदा क्रियते सेतुर्वानरै र्घोरकर्मभिः ।दण्डनन्ये प्रगृह्णन्ति विचिन्वन्ति तथापरे ॥६-२२-६२॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa tadā kriyate seturvānarai rghorakarmabhiḥ ।daṇḍananye pragṛhṇanti vicinvanti tathāpare ॥6-22-62॥।।

translations.english: Others held sticks and some held logs of wood and reeds following the command of Rama, hundreds of Vanaras who looked like clouds and mountain tops built the bridge.

verses.sloka: वानरैः शतशस्तत्र रामस्यज्ञापुरःसरैः ।मेघाभैः पर्वताभश्च तृणैः काष्ठैर्बबन्धरे ॥६-२२-६३॥।।
verses.transliteration: vānaraiḥ śataśastatra rāmasyajñāpuraḥsaraiḥ ।meghābhaiḥ parvatābhaśca tṛṇaiḥ kāṣṭhairbabandhare ॥6-22-63॥।।

translations.english: Others held sticks and some held logs of wood and reeds following the command of Rama, hundreds of Vanaras who looked like clouds and mountain tops built the bridge.
translations.hindi: कोई कोई वानर हाथों में डंडे ले कर वानरों से काम जल्दी पूरा कराने के जिये खड़े थे, कोई इधर उधर घूम किर कर बड़े बड़े पेड़ को ढूढ रहे थे । इस प्रकार श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की अज्ञा से सैकड़ों बानर

verses.sloka: पुष्पिताग्रैश्च तरुभिः सेतुम् बध्नन्ति वानराः ।पाषाणाम्श्च गिरिप्रख्यान् गिरीणाम् शिखराणि च ॥६-२२-६४॥।।
verses.transliteration: puṣpitāgraiśca tarubhiḥ setum badhnanti vānarāḥ ।pāṣāṇāmśca giriprakhyān girīṇām śikharāṇi ca ॥6-22-64॥।।

translations.english: The Vanaras who were like Danavas, huge mountains in size were seen seizing boulders from the mountain, the trees with blossoms, and creepers for binding the bridge and running.
translations.hindi: जिनका शरीर पत्त और मेघ की तरह बिशाज था; तृण काठ, पुष्पित वृक्षां तथा पत्थरों से पुत्त वाँधने का काम कर रहे ' थे

verses.sloka: दृश्यन्ते परिधावन्तो गृह्य दानवसम्निभाः ।शिलानाम् क्षिप्यमाणानाम् शैलानाम् तत्र पात्यताम् ॥६-२२-६५॥।।
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante paridhāvanto gṛhya dānavasamnibhāḥ ।śilānām kṣipyamāṇānām śailānām tatra pātyatām ॥6-22-65॥।।

translations.english: By hurling off the mountains in that lofty ocean and throwing stones, a tumultuous sound arose.

verses.sloka: बभूव तुमुलः शब्दस् तदा तस्मिन् महाउदधौ ।कृतानि प्रथमेनाह्ना योजनानि चतुर्दश ॥६-२२-६६॥।।
verses.transliteration: babhūva tumulaḥ śabdas tadā tasmin mahāudadhau ।kṛtāni prathamenāhnā yojanāni caturdaśa ॥6-22-66॥।।

translations.english: Elephants like monkeys rejoiced over building speedily fourteen yojanas the distance of the bridge on the first day.
translations.hindi: उस समुद्र में शिलाओं के डालने और पर्वेतो के पटकने से बड़ा शब्द होता था

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टैजसम्काशैस्त्वरमाणैः प्लवङ्गमैः ।द्वितीयेन तथैवाह्ना योजनानि तु विशतिः ॥६-२२-६७॥।।
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭaijasamkāśaistvaramāṇaiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ ।dvitīyena tathaivāhnā yojanāni tu viśatiḥ ॥6-22-67॥।।

translations.english: In the same order the Vanaras of fierce bodies and extremely strong ones soon built twenty yojanas on the second day.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार गज के समान शरीर वाले ओर फुर्तीले वानर ने बड़ी प्रसन्नता के साथ प्रथम दिन चांद योजन लंबा पुल बना डाला

verses.sloka: कृतानि प्लवगैस्तूर्णम् भीमकायैर्महाबलैः ।अह्ना तृतीयेन तथा योजनानि तु सागरे ॥६-२२-६८॥।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtāni plavagaistūrṇam bhīmakāyairmahābalaiḥ ।ahnā tṛtīyena tathā yojanāni tu sāgare ॥6-22-68॥।।

translations.english: Endowed with huge body that way the Vanaras built extremely fast, twenty one yojanas on the third day.
translations.hindi: फिर भयङ्कर शरीर वाले महाबली वानरों ने फुर्ती से दूसरे दिन वीस योजन लंबा पुल बाँध कर तैयार कि

verses.sloka: त्वरमाणैर्महाकयैरेकविम्शतिरेव च ।चतुर्थेन तथा चाह्ना द्वाविम्शतिरथापि वा ॥६-२२-६९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tvaramāṇairmahākayairekavimśatireva ca ।caturthena tathā cāhnā dvāvimśatirathāpi vā ॥6-22-69॥।।

translations.english: There upon at once Vanaras of great speed built twenty two yojanas on the fourth day.

verses.sloka: योजनानि महावेगैः कृतानि त्वरितैस्ततः ।पञ्चमेन तथा चाह्ना प्लवगैः क्षिप्रकारिभिः ॥६-२२-७०॥।।
verses.transliteration: yojanāni mahāvegaiḥ kṛtāni tvaritaistataḥ ।pañcamena tathā cāhnā plavagaiḥ kṣiprakāribhiḥ ॥6-22-70॥।।

translations.english: Similarly, on the fifth day the Vanaras endowed with great impetus built twenty three yojanas and crossed Mount Suvela.

verses.sloka: योजनानि त्रयोविम्शत्सुवेलमधिकृत्य वै ।स वानरवरः श्रीमान् विश्वकर्मात्मजो बली ॥६-२२-७१॥।।
verses.transliteration: yojanāni trayovimśatsuvelamadhikṛtya vai ।sa vānaravaraḥ śrīmān viśvakarmātmajo balī ॥6-22-71॥।।

translations.english: Nala the son of Vishwakarma, the foremost of the Vanaras and strong like his father built the bridge in the sea.

verses.sloka: बबन्ध सागरे सेतुम् यथा चास्य तथा पिता ।स नलेन कृतः सेतुः सागरे मकर आलये ॥६-२२-७२॥।।
verses.transliteration: babandha sāgare setum yathā cāsya tathā pitā ।sa nalena kṛtaḥ setuḥ sāgare makara ālaye ॥6-22-72॥।।

translations.english: The bridge was built on the sea, an abode of crocodiles, was auspicious, glorious, and looked like the street in space (milky path).

verses.sloka: शुशुभे सुभगः श्रीमान् स्वाती पथ इव अम्बरे ।ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च परम ऋषयः ॥६-२२-७३॥।।
verses.transliteration: śuśubhe subhagaḥ śrīmān svātī patha iva ambare ।tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ ॥6-22-73॥।।

translations.english: The Gandharvas, gods and even siddhas felt happy and reached their stationed in the sky to see the wonderful bridge.

verses.sloka: आगम्य गगने तस्थुर्द्रष्टुकामास्तदद्भुतम् ।दशयोजनविस्तीर्णम् शतयोजन मायतम् ॥६-२२-७४॥।।
verses.transliteration: āgamya gagane tasthurdraṣṭukāmāstadadbhutam ।daśayojanavistīrṇam śatayojana māyatam ॥6-22-74॥।।

translations.english: Gods and Gandharvas witnessed the bridge built by Nala that was ten yojanas in width and hundred yojanas in length.
translations.hindi: नल द्वारा बना हुआ वह पुत्र एसो शोभा द रहा था, जया! शोमा आकाश में छायापथ की होती हे ।! ७३ ॥ ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमपयः । आगम्य गगने तस्थुद ष्टुकामास्तदः तस्‌

verses.sloka: ददृशुर्देवगन्धर्वा नलसेतुम् सुदुष्करम् ।आप्लवन्तः प्लवन्तः च गर्जन्तः च प्लवम् गमाः ॥६-२२-७५॥।।
verses.transliteration: dadṛśurdevagandharvā nalasetum suduṣkaram ।āplavantaḥ plavantaḥ ca garjantaḥ ca plavam gamāḥ ॥6-22-75॥।।

translations.english: The monkeys were jumping about here and there roaring (in joy). All creatures witnessed the bridge that was inconceivable, marvellous, thrilling, and impossible to build constructed in the sea.
translations.hindi: देवताओं और गन्धर्वो ने नल का बनाया हुआ, अत्यन्त दुष्कर सो योजन लंबा और दस योजन चौड़ा पुल देखा

verses.sloka: तम् अचिन्त्यम् असह्यम् च अद्भुतम् लोम हर्षणम् ।ददृशुः सर्व भूतानि सागरे सेतु बन्धनम् ॥६-२२-७६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tam acintyam asahyam ca adbhutam loma harṣaṇam ।dadṛśuḥ sarva bhūtāni sāgare setu bandhanam ॥6-22-76॥।।

translations.english: The monkeys were jumping about here and there roaring (in joy). All creatures witnessed the bridge that was inconceivable, marvellous, thrilling, and impossible to build constructed in the sea.
translations.hindi: वह सेतु समुद्र के बीच ऐसा शोभायमान हो रहा या जैसे {त्यों के सर वी माँग । तदनन्तर हाथ म गदा ले बिभीषण अपने मंत्रियों सहित समुद्र के उस पार शत्रुआ का मारने के लिए जा खड़े हुए । तब सुग्रीव ने' सत्यपराक्रमी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा

verses.sloka: तानि कोटि सहस्राणि वानराणाम् महाओजसाम् ।बध्नन्तः सागरे सेतुम् जग्मुः पारम् महाउदधेः ॥६-२२-७७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tāni koṭi sahasrāṇi vānarāṇām mahāojasām ।badhnantaḥ sāgare setum jagmuḥ pāram mahāudadheḥ ॥6-22-77॥।।

translations.english: The glorious Vanaras in thousands of crores reached the other side of the sea from the bridge constructed in the great sea.

verses.sloka: विशालः सुकृतः श्रीमान् सुभूमिः सुसमाहितः ।अशोभत महासेतुः सीमन्त इव सागरे ॥६-२२-७८॥।।
verses.transliteration: viśālaḥ sukṛtaḥ śrīmān subhūmiḥ susamāhitaḥ ।aśobhata mahāsetuḥ sīmanta iva sāgare ॥6-22-78॥।।

translations.english: That huge bridge was well built, magnificent, evenly built, and extensive and looked charming like the partition in a woman's hair.
translations.hindi: र बन्नन्तः सागरे सेतुं जग्मुः पारं सहोदध; । विशालः सुकृतः^ रशरीमान्सुमूमिः सुसमा हिंतः४; । ७८ / | सेतु बाँच कर समुद्र के पाए हा गए। नल ने जो पुल बावा था, वह बडा लंबा चौड़ा था, बड़ा मजबूत था, सीधा था, नीचा चा न हो कर समान चौरस था और उसमें गड्ढे भी न थे

verses.sloka: ततः परे समुद्रस्य गदा पाणिर् विभीषणः ।परेषाम् अभिघत अर्थम् अतिष्ठत् सचिवैः सह ॥६-२२-७९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pare samudrasya gadā pāṇir vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।pareṣām abhighata artham atiṣṭhat sacivaiḥ saha ॥6-22-79॥।।

translations.english: There upon Vibheeshana holding the mace stood on the other side of the ocean along with his friends to slay the enemies.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवस्तु ततः प्राह रामम् सत्यपराक्रमम् ।हनुमन्तम् त्वमारोह अङ्गदम् त्वथ लक्ष्मणः ॥६-२२-८०॥।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvastu tataḥ prāha rāmam satyaparākramam ।hanumantam tvamāroha aṅgadam tvatha lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥6-22-80॥।।

translations.english: Sugriva addressed Rama of truthful valour and said, "You mount on heroic Hanuman, let Lakshmana climb on Angada. These Vanaras will hold you up in the sky and assist you to cross the ocean."

verses.sloka: अयम् हि विपुलो वीर सागरो मकरालयः ।वैहायसौ युवामेतौ वानरौ धारयिष्यतः ॥६-२२-८१॥।।
verses.transliteration: ayam hi vipulo vīra sāgaro makarālayaḥ ।vaihāyasau yuvāmetau vānarau dhārayiṣyataḥ ॥6-22-81॥।।

translations.english: Sugriva addressed Rama of truthful valour and said, "You mount on heroic Hanuman, let Lakshmana climb on Angada. These Vanaras will hold you up in the sky and assist you to cross the ocean."
translations.hindi: हे वीर ! आप हनुमान जी पर ओर लक्षमण जी अङ्गद पर सवार हो लें क्‍योंकि यह समुद्र मगर मच्छा का हे ओर ये दोना आकाशचारी बानर हैं, अतः आप दोनों को अली भाँति समुद्र पार पहुँचा देंगे। तब उस वानरी सेना के आगे आगे ह ; भाई श्रीराम आर लच्मण हाथ में घनुष बाण ने सुश्रीव को अपने साथ लिये हुए चले। कोई कोई कपियूथपति बीच मं और कोई अगल बगल और पीछे हो लिये

verses.sloka: अग्रतस् तस्य सैन्यस्य श्रीमान् रामः सलक्ष्मणः ।जगाम धन्वी धर्म आत्मा सुग्रीवेण समन्वितः ॥६-२२-८२॥।।
verses.transliteration: agratas tasya sainyasya śrīmān rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ।jagāma dhanvī dharma ātmā sugrīveṇa samanvitaḥ ॥6-22-82॥।।

translations.english: Accompanied by Lakshmana and joined together with Sugriva, glorious and righteous Rama walked in front of the army.

verses.sloka: अन्ये मध्येन गच्चन्ति पार्श्वतो अन्ये प्लवम् गमाः ।सलिले प्रपतन्ति अन्ये मार्गम् अन्ये न लेभिरे ॥६-२२-८३॥।।
verses.transliteration: anye madhyena gaccanti pārśvato anye plavam gamāḥ ।salile prapatanti anye mārgam anye na lebhire ॥6-22-83॥।।

translations.english: While some monkeys walked in the middle some went in the side, some others were falling down in water (for the want of space to walk) some others went like birds in the path of the sky.

verses.sloka: केचिद् वैहायस गताः सुपर्णा इव पुप्लुवुः ।घोषेण महता घोषम् सागरस्य समुच्च्रितम् ॥६-२२-८४॥।।
verses.transliteration: kecid vaihāyasa gatāḥ suparṇā iva pupluvuḥ ।ghoṣeṇa mahatā ghoṣam sāgarasya samuccritam ॥6-22-84॥।।

translations.english: The terrific sound caused by the frightening advancement of massive monkey troops the sound of the ocean got drowned.

verses.sloka: भीमम् अन्तर् दधे भीमा तरन्ती हरि वाहिनी ।वानराणाम् हि सा तीर्णा वाहिनी नल सेतुना ॥६-२२-८५॥।।
verses.transliteration: bhīmam antar dadhe bhīmā tarantī hari vāhinī ।vānarāṇām hi sā tīrṇā vāhinī nala setunā ॥6-22-85॥।।

translations.english: The Vanara army having crossed the bridge of Nala by the king's order settled on the other shore that was filled with several roots and fruits.
translations.hindi: वानरों की संख्या अत्यधिक ओर रास्ता सङ्कीणे होने के कारण बहुत से वानर पानी में गिर पडे और बहुत से रास्ता न मिलने के कारण समुद्रतट पर इस पार ठ रहे । बहुत गरुड की तरह उड़ कर आकाश साग से गये ॥ ८४ hi ` घोषेण महता तस्य सिन्धोर्घोप सम्रुच्छ्रितम्‌ । भीममन्तदेधे भीमा तरन्ती हरिवाहिनी

verses.sloka: तीरे निविविशे राज्ञा बहु मूल फल उदके ।तद् अद्भुतम् राघव कर्म दुष्करम् ।समीक्ष्य देवाः सह सिद्ध चारणैः ।उपेत्य रामम् सहिता महर्षिभिः ।समभ्यषिन्चन् सुशुभिअर् जलैः पृथक् ॥६-२२-८६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tīre niviviśe rājñā bahu mūla phala udake ।tad adbhutam rāghava karma duṣkaram ।samīkṣya devāḥ saha siddha cāraṇaiḥ ।upetya rāmam sahitā maharṣibhiḥ ।samabhyaṣincan suśubhiar jalaiḥ pṛthak ॥6-22-86॥।।

translations.english: At once the gods, siddhas, charanas and sages came towards Rama looking at his wonderful and most difficult action and sprinkled auspicious water on him individually. (As a mark of worship and blessing).
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार नल के बनाए हुए पुल से वह सेना समुद्र के पार हो गयी । उस पार पहुँच, सुग्रीब ने उनको अधिक फलमलपूण समुद्रतट पर ठहरा दिया

verses.sloka: जयस्व शत्रून् नर देव मेदिनीम् ।ससागराम् पालय शाश्वतीः समाः ।इति इव रामम् नर देव सत्कृतम् ।शुभैर् वचोभिर् विविधैर् अपूजयन् ॥६-२२-८७॥
verses.transliteration: jayasva śatrūn nara deva medinīm ।sasāgarām pālaya śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।iti iva rāmam nara deva satkṛtam ।śubhair vacobhir vividhair apūjayan ॥6-22-87॥

translations.english: "O Rama the Lord of human beings Let you win over enemies and rule the land for ever." Thus, hailing Rama who is worshipped by humans as well as gods, was worshipped with auspicious words (by the aforesaid gods, siddhas and charanas). ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्वाविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
